ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 35:65 ratio of high-intensity white pixels (mottling and scars) to low-intensity dark gray/black background pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Concentrated high-intensity white pixel clusters at the distal tips of both lobes; high-frequency white mottling distributed across the mid-sections of both lobes; distinct linear white patterns on the proximal region of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the entire trailing edge boundary; presence of multiple sharp peaks and shallow valleys with pixel amplitudes varying between 5 and 25 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve extending from the median notch to the distal tips, showing increasing positive slope towards the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Global distribution of roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (2-10 pixels in diameter), with the highest density concentrated at the distal lobe tips and along the trailing edges.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of 4-5 prominent, parallel high-intensity linear tracks (rake marks) visible on the lower-medial quadrant of the left lobe, oriented diagonally toward the outer edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive parallel linear scarring on the left lobe; heavy colonization of high-intensity white calcified organisms (likely barnacles) visible on the leading edges and distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-contrast white 'slash' marking on the medial region of the right lobe, adjacent to the notch.
